notes:
Lead summary: small regional telehealth / wellness vendor building a clinician-facing summarization and search tool for visit notes. Wants quick self-serve path but is HIPAA-adjacent — cautious about storing PHI. Primary ask = hosted API for speed of iteration, but needs explicit retention controls and a way to opt-out of logging.

Key pain: current search is keyword-only, results noisy; embeddings approach looks promising to surface relevant past notes. Latency target for ui: <400ms for top-k embedding queries; batch inference for summarization OK up to 2s. Cost: sensitive — prefers predictable per-call pricing for prototypes.

Security asks (from CTO & head of ops):
- "Do you offer a BAA?" — customer wording. They are not yet enterprise but may require BAA later.
- Data retention controls: must be able to delete logs and turn off persistent storage of prompts/outputs for test data.
- Encryption/KMS: keys at rest; who holds keys?
- Residency: US-only storage preferred.
- Audit logs and SSO: Ok to integrate SAML later.

Notes from call: "We don't plan to send unredacted PHI in prod, but dev/test will have edge cases" — CTO. They asked if Redwood hosted API can be used for dev without contractual BAA if they mask PII.

Technical details gathered:
- Expected QPS during pilot: 1-3 rps for chat/summarize flows; embeddings traffic spike during nightly indexing (500-1,000 vectors ingest per run).
- Models preferred: smaller Llama/opt-flavor variants for summarization, embedder-based vectors for search.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to lower-cost model when in free trial, prefer to pin model in prod.

Next steps (short):
- Omar to run SE demo focusing on retention controls and masking patterns (week of 2026-03-15).
- Provide example minimal deployment README to show how to disable logging + use ephemeral keys.
- Confirm whether a limited BAA evaluation (pilot clause) is possible or what enterprise path looks like.

Staged asks / deal appetite: small pilot (3 months), potential to convert to Dedicated or Private long term if BAA and residency required. Customer seeks clear migration path (hosted -> dedicated) that preserves API surface.

CRM shorthand / snippets:
- "Pilot intent: embed search + summarization — low latency front-end importance"
- "Cost band: low — keep initial monthly <$2k if possible"
- "Blocker: BAA + retention policy confirmation"
